messages:
Maria (AE): AcmeLegal pushed back with the SIG/CAIQ and a hard deadline: they want SCC fallback copy, a DSAR deletion proof example, and an up-to-date subprocessor list by EOD PST.
Sam (SE): looping in @Lee and @Jordan. I exported their SIG CSV from the portal earlier this morning.
Sam (SE): They specifically flagged cross-border transfer flow, runtime key rotation, and whether we can pre-sign an SCC annex before private deployment.
Lee (Security): I can take the SIG technical questions. For key rotation we can provide a high-level statement of frequency and a redacted audit entry. No raw keys.
Jordan (Legal): Will draft a short, contract-ready fallback sentence for SCCs. Keep it flexible for unknown countries.
Maria (AE): They also want an example package as proof for DSAR deletion requests 1 what exactly do we typically hand them?
Anya (CS): We bundle a zipped package: sanitized logs, the deletion confirmation record, and a signed support letter. That usually meets auditor needs.
Anya (CS): DSAR flow (short): 1) validate requester identity 2) locate data across storage/logs 3) execute deletion or provide export 4) generate confirmation and audit entry 5) close.
Sam (SE): sample sanitized deletion log (for their review):
```
2026-02-10T22:14:33Z INFO dsar.processed account_id=cust_987 scope=all deletion_confirmed=true ticket=SR-2001
```
Lee (Security): For subprocessors, point them to our published feed: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors and note the last-modified timestamp in the reply.
Jordan (Legal): Draft fallback clause suggestion: "If standard contractual clauses or other approved transfer mechanisms are unavailable for certain jurisdictions, the parties will agree on an alternative lawful transfer arrangement reasonably acceptable to both parties (including binding corporate rules or successor instruments). Provider will notify Customer within 30 days of material changes affecting transfer mechanisms."
Maria (AE): Can we add a single-line about notification timing? Your sentence covers it, thanks.
Lee (Security): Uploaded two redacted log snippets and an RSA rotation statement to the secure artifacts portal: https://portal.redwood.example.com/artifacts/AL-2309 (ops can verify).
Sam (SE): Note on SCC annex pre-signing: Ops said feasible but requires SOW amendment and timeline shift. That changes costing.
Finance Ops: Placeholder cost impact posted in the shared doc. We need SE to enumerate infra changes to firm the estimate.
Maria (AE): Good note. This is a potential upsell to Dedicated/Private if they insist on on-prem transfer controls.
Anya (CS): I'll paste a customer-facing deletion confirmation template and link our DSAR playbook for internal reviewers.
Anya (CS): Customer deletion confirmation template: "We have removed the requested personal data from our production systems. Attached: deletion audit, ticket, and signed support confirmation."
Sam (SE): I'll assemble an internal SIG answers spreadsheet + attach Lee's rotation statement and Anya's DSAR package.
Jordan (Legal): Will post the SCC fallback one-liner into the draft contract annex so they can drop it in.
SIGBot: Reminder: security-review-deadline in ~5h. Upload the final SIG responses to the secure portal: https://portal.redwood.example.com/sig-upload
Maria (AE): Plan: compile SIG answers + SCC language + DSAR evidence + cost placeholder into one zip and send by 17:30 PST. Scheduling a 30-min follow-up call for tomorrow.
Lee (Security): I added an ops contact for verification and a short explanation of what we can/can't provide (no raw key material).
Finance Ops: If they move to Dedicated/Private we'll need an initial 3-month commit. Estimate updated after SE input.
Maria (AE): Sent the package to AcmeLegal at 17:22 PST. Included links to artifacts, the fallback text, and the DSAR evidence bundle. Asking for confirmation of receipt.
Sam (SE): LGTM. If they request deeper proofs we can offer sanitized architecture diagrams and an annotated network flow.
Jordan (Legal): I'll monitor for contract redlines. Will circulate an updated draft once Lee's logs are verified.
Anya (CS): Leaving the internal DSAR playbook link here: https://internal.redwood.com/dsar-playbook (internal only).
Maria (AE): Thanks everyone, good work :thumbsup:
